s: Count trials as joy. Be doers of the word, not hearers only.
Do not favour the rich. Faith without works is dead.
The tongue is small but powerful. Wisdom from above.
Humble yourselves before God. Do not speak evil of one another.
Warning to the rich. Be patient. Anoint the sick, confess your sins to one another and pray.

3: In older English “conversation” meant way of life and conduct, not talk.
